title: Mapping the Italian Telegram Ecosystem: Communities, Toxicity, and Hate Speech
findings: Judaism is the most frequently targeted religion across all analyzed communities, accounting for 57% to 85% of all religion-related hostility. Islam is the second most targeted, receiving about 20% of religion-related attacks in most communities. This indicates a high concentration of antisemitic and Islamophobic narratives. Other religious groups are targeted far less frequently. These patterns were largely stable across different communities.
